requirement_vague: Verify article feed only returns articles from followed users

omissions.description: The GET /api/articles/feed endpoint is completely missing from the code. There is no route that returns articles authored by users that the current user follows.
omissions.reasoning: The requirement specifies calling GET /api/articles/feed to retrieve articles from followed users. Searching the entire codebase, no such route is defined. The existing article routes are POST /api/articles, GET /api/articles, GET /api/articles/{slug}, PUT /api/articles/{slug}, and DELETE /api/articles/{slug}. None of these implement feed functionality.
